requirements.title: Discover exactly the eligible memory files

acceptance.description: Compare roots, nested Markdown, case sensitivity, order, hidden artifacts and disappearing files.
Exclude or admit symlinks and non-regular files exactly as the pinned reference does.

requirements.title: Enforce memory path and read boundaries

acceptance.description: Exercise absolute, relative, traversal, encoded and symlink paths.
Compare rejected operations, result shapes and absence of unintended writes.
Compare append, replace, exclusive creation and concurrent rename outcomes.
Inject write, flush, fsync and publication failures and inspect the surviving files.

requirements.title: Keep workspace and subject state separate

acceptance.description: Reuse one host configuration across distinct workspaces and subjects.
Prove files, indexes, recalls and maintenance state cannot cross the selected boundary.
Compare exported token sets for empty, repeated, ASCII, mixed-script, CJK and Unicode boundary inputs.
Use deterministic generated strings as well as named cases; preserve all observable tokens.
Compare query strings and no-query outcomes for punctuation, quotes, identifiers, whitespace and mixed scripts.
Exercise deterministic generated inputs without reconstructing the reference algorithm in the oracle.
Compare positive, negative, zero and boundary ranks, including supported non-finite input representations.
Report numerical differences rather than masking score-gate changes with a blanket tolerance.
Compare ordered chunks, lines, overlap, empty content, headings and per-entry curated files.
Read the original source through every returned line range.

requirements.title: Match UTF-16 and CJK chunk budgets

acceptance.description: Exercise surrogate pairs, malformed surrogates, CJK weighting and exact budget boundaries.
Compare truncation and overlap without splitting valid pairs or changing source ranges.
Compare chunk hashes, entry boundaries, source identities and provenance fields.
Verify unchanged and changed inputs produce the reference identities and invalidation decisions.
Vary provider, model, endpoint settings, scope, sources, tokenizer and chunking versions.
Compare missing, matching and stale metadata diagnostics before any query is admitted.
Create, update, rename and delete files and sessions while retaining an index.
Compare discovery, chunk replacement and unchanged-file handling across reopen.
Interleave readers with successful and failing rebuilds.
Compare visible old/new revisions and prevent partial chunk, FTS or provenance publication.
Use a deterministic instrumented embedder to count query and document calls.
Compare cache identity, batching, changed chunks, failed batches and retained entries.
Query an empty or stale index before and after source changes.
Compare forced-sync/retry policy, unavailable outcomes and dispatch counts.
Compare cosine scoring, candidate bounds, zero vectors and incompatible dimensions.
Compare ordered source/range identities before downstream hybrid ranking.

requirements.title: Match hybrid merge and score gates

acceptance.description: Compare vector-only, text-only, overlapping and disjoint candidates with configured weights.
Check selection, minimum-score boundaries and lexical fallback without dropping result fields.
Exercise exact paths, basename matches, partial paths and body-only matches.
Compare path specificity tiers, ties and interaction with content score.
Compare disabled/enabled MMR, duplicate text, equal scores, stable ties and lambda boundaries.
Exercise CJK, empty and punctuation-only snippets and preserve output ordering.
Compare enabled/disabled decay, half-life boundaries, future dates and missing timestamps.
Compare dated versus evergreen memory paths and session activity timestamps under a fixed clock.
Exercise importance annotations, triggers and active/inactive project keys.
Compare multipliers and their order relative to path tiers, decay and MMR.
Compare definitions, accepted parameters, coercion, defaults, corpora and rejection errors.
Compare complete ordered payloads, citations, warnings and source metadata.
Compare allowed files, line windows, UTF-16 budgets, continuation hints and missing sources.
Compare exact status/error shapes and returned source text.
Control clocks and slow providers to exercise absolute deadlines and cooldown transitions.
Compare subsequent admission, provider call counts and memory/wiki/session independence.

requirements.title: Match unavailable and partial corpus outcomes

acceptance.description: Fail individual providers and supplemental corpora independently.
Compare partial results, timed-out flags, warnings and recovery on a later explicit query.
Compare accepted session kinds, ownership, participants, archives and generated maintenance sessions.
Provide the same host metadata and compare included and excluded entries.
Compare JSONL trees, tool rows, heartbeat markers, recalled content and failed or mirrored messages.
Exercise reset fences, malformed rows and supported archives without inventing stored text.
Vary visible sessions, source identities, trust and forgotten origins.
Compare hits, provenance and source reads before and after reset or deletion.
Compare transcript projection, naming, timezone, slug behavior and exclusive publication.
Verify source lines, trust records, collision handling and recall after the hook.
Persist actual transcript and session metadata and reconstruct the host in a fresh process.
Compare continuation, ordering and retained context without relying on process-local lists.
Exercise setup states, session kinds, available files and compatibility layouts.
Compare ensure decisions, selected files and their order under the same inputs.
Exercise per-file, USER.md and aggregate UTF-16 limits and exact boundary values.
Compare clipping, omitted files, warning modes and once-per-session state.

requirements.title: Match memory and runtime prompt composition

acceptance.description: Compare memory guidance, tools, runtime markers and fixed clock/timezone fragments.
Compare insertion order and isolation of untrusted or recalled text.

requirements.title: Match history windowing and tool repair

acceptance.description: Exercise missing results, duplicate or invalid calls, failed turns and provider replay metadata.
Compare repaired model-visible messages while preserving the original durable transcript.

requirements.title: Match flush plan and target selection

acceptance.description: Compare enabled/disabled configuration, model selection, timezone and daily target validation.
Compare prompts, reserve terms and failure before a target can be safely prepared.
Feed fresh/stale usage, missing usage, transcript byte limits and compaction counters.
Compare trigger decisions, heartbeat exclusions and retry/exhaustion state.
Run the same labelled model/tool sequence through both hosts.
Compare append-only writes, index readiness, provenance and successful or failed cycle stamps.
Exercise promotion sections mixed with user text and exact size/loss limits.
Compare preserved bytes, removed sections, deferral and reconciliation markers.

requirements.title: Match context assembly and compaction replay

acceptance.description: Compare active transcript projections, summaries, checkpoints, tool-result bounds and replay decisions.
Retain trailing required results and provider continuation data across restart.
Drive preflight and mid-turn overflow, truncation, compact/retry and terminal failures.
Compare dispatch counts, protected messages and exact continuation/admission decisions.
Compare filtering, deduplication, query hashes, day boundaries, retention and recall events.
Verify ground truth source ranges and origin recording before published recall state.
Compare scores, custom weights, tie order, diversity, age, trust and visibility gates.
Include exact score thresholds and promoted-entry visibility.
Compare MEMORY.md/DREAMS.md, markers, authoritative candidates and applied/rejected receipts.
Interleave candidate changes and verify lock-time rechecks and publication order.
Feed identical deterministic model plans for added, merged, superseded and rejected entries.
Compare preimages, loss safeguards, history, origin changes and deterministic fallback.
Compare ingestion, freshness, ordering, deduplication, evidence grouping and selection.
Compare live-source checks, staged-key state, phase signals and published artifacts.
Compare narrative/evidence extraction and staged-key preference, consumption and freshness.
Compare diary outputs, live-source checks and failure/publication semantics.
Compare eligibility, consolidation invocation, fallback and phase composition.
Compare phase ordering, source provenance and all resulting memory/recall state.
Compare diary structure, coverage, evidence references, timestamps and artifact trust.
Inject publisher failures and concurrent changes and compare locks and durable receipts.
Exercise dry-run and commit for direct, promoted, mixed-lineage and missing origins.
Compare retained/deleted memory, lineage, tombstones and same-session replay admission.
Interleave forget with rebuild, search and promotion using the same source revisions.
Prove a stale rebuild cannot republish forgotten entries, including after restart.
Compare literal registered secrets, structured credentials and model/tool/transcript policies.
Compare bounded chunks, sanitization order and failure diagnostics without leaking live credentials.

requirements.title: Match configured patterns and trust transitions

acceptance.description: Compare supported JavaScript regex patterns, mode overrides and full-context walking.
Compare owner/taint/provenance transitions at tool time and through stored session state.
Compare read/write/unset/delete, size limits, tombstones and doctor migrations.
Compare persisted state and diagnostics after reconstruction.

requirements.title: Match heartbeat turn inputs and reply handling

acceptance.description: Compare skip/run decisions, prompt inputs, due tasks, NO_REPLY and HEARTBEAT_OK handling.
Compare flush exclusion and removal from the session-memory corpus.
Compare schedule parsing, due decisions, run recording and migration outcomes under a fixed clock.
Drive jobs explicitly; compare observable memory inputs and outputs without cloning an OS scheduler.
Exercise simultaneous writers in separate processes, lock timeout, owner death and stale recovery.
Compare exclusion, lease/reclaim behavior and absence of cross-workspace interference.
Corrupt recall stores, indexes, provenance and lock artifacts independently.
Compare diagnostic codes, retained valid state and repair effects without silently resetting data.
Interrupt write, index, flush, consolidation, forget and diary publication at defined boundaries.
Compare next-open behavior, partial outcomes, unknown operations and retry policy.
Exercise coercion, non-finite numbers, negative zero, integer limits and exact score gates.
Compare decisions and serialization; document any operation-specific tolerance without masking inclusion changes.
Exercise UTF-16 units, lone surrogates, case folding, segmentation and path ordering.
Compare ordering and truncation for deterministic generated and named multilingual cases.

requirements.title: Match date/time and regex edge behavior

acceptance.description: Compare supported date parsing, offsets, DST boundaries, locale-independent clocks and regex options.
Classify unsupported source behavior as a mismatch or uncovered requirement, never an implicit match.

requirements.title: Finalize memory before the next turn

acceptance.description: Drive a natural first-turn save and an immediate follow-up in both host paths.
Compare committed and searchable memory, serialized maintenance and visible failure before next admission.

requirements.title: Recall across fresh chats and process restart

acceptance.description: Use the same saved corpus with a fresh session and then a fresh host process.
Compare source-backed retrieval and state continuity with facts omitted from the new prompt.

requirements.title: Update current facts while preserving isolation

acceptance.description: Replace a prior preference, retain unrelated facts and query from independent user/workspace scopes.
Compare current versus superseded answers and honest write/index failure reporting.

outOfScope: Gateway process startup, transport implementation and the OpenClaw daemon lifecycle, except their externally observable memory ordering and failure effects.
Browser UI, channel integrations, CLI surface and plugin packaging.
Operating-system scheduling, deployment authentication and sandbox implementation; the memory admission, trust and explicitly driven scheduling decisions they supply remain in scope.
Provider/plugin registration and transport SDK internals; memory-facing embedding, usage, cancellation and error semantics remain in scope.
Binary interchange with OpenClaw's private SQLite schema; observable memory contents, identities, concurrency and durability remain in scope.
Python-only curation/live/framework conveniences have separate regression tests and do not count as native equivalence evidence.
